selection_rationale: The 24 pre-registered seed-0 and seed-1 scenarios had no initial nontraining joint-marked candidate. Training seed 2 is the third and final sequential pre-registered discovery batch. Scenario selection does not use a global optimum or any nontraining true ED/LP cost. This is not formal and is not evidence of quantum advantage. The candidate condition remains strictly initial_nontraining_joint_marked_count > 0.
